_help: Playable maps. 'arena' is the built-in level inside scenes/main.tscn (scene = ""), and it is the default and the fallback. Other maps follow docs/map_contract (res://maps/<id>/<id>.tscn). Pick one with the project setting game/maps/default_map, the command-line user arg --map=<id> (after --), or MapRegistry.select(id) from a menu, then reload main.tscn.

maps.description: The original walled arena: brick alley, tower, platform. Fully open, 7 spawns.
Overrun steel works. Fight from the Loading Yard through the Warehouse to the Foundry Hall and Tank Farm.
Quarantined municipal substation. Open switchyard, a grated deck, and a sealed battery vault where the boss waits.
Night rail depot, our biggest yard: ten rooms, boxcar roofs and catwalks, and a boss at the turntable pit.
